acceptanceCriteria: A relative key whose SHA-256 matches binds the anchored file; an escaping relative key (../) is refused; both pinned by tests.
Ambiguity (absolute and relative keys both binding) still abstains as js-source-not-bound.
body: Found in V1-1858 (PR #1161, head 2817789aa, corvint build 664). Expected: relative testFileDigests keys (relative to the repository root) bind the anchored file too. Actual: only absolute in-root keys bind; otherwise discovery reports js-source-not-bound and keeps the projection unchanged.
title: JS/TS hygiene discovery binds only absolute testFileDigests keys inside the root
